notes.title: Shooting Range Simulator Launches Early Access on September 3rd!
notes.content: [p]Get ready to take control of your very own shooting range – [b]Shooting Range Simulator[/b] officially launches on [b]September 3rd[/b]! 🗓️[/p][p]Manage every aspect of your range: keep your shelves stocked, rent out a variety of firearms, and sell ammo packs to eager customers. Expand and upgrade your shop to attract more visitors, level up your popularity, and unlock access to even better equipment.[/p][p]Test your luck by opening cases, then sell the skins you find for profit. Prove your skills in thrilling shooting tournaments, climb the rankings, and show that you’re the best in the business.[/p][p][/p][p]Link For Shooting Range Simulator: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967850/Shooting_Range_Simulator/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967850/Shooting_Range_Simulator/[/url][/p][p]Follow and Wishlist it now![/p][p][/p][p][b]At launch, you can expect:[/b][/p][list][*][p]🏪 Full shooting range management gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]🔫 Gun rentals, ammo sales, and supply management[/p][/*][*][p]💼 Shop expansion and upgrades for better gear[/p][/*][*][p]🎯 Competitive shooting tournaments[/p][/*][*][p]🎁 Case openings and skin trading[/p][/*][/list][p]Mark your calendars – [b]September 3rd[/b] is the day to build, manage, and run your dream shooting range![/p]

notes.title: Full Release Roadmap
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We’re excited to share the roadmap for the full version of Shooting Range Simulator!
This is a glimpse of what we’ve been working on — and what’s coming next!

📌 Your feedback is super important to us, so feel free to share your thoughts, ideas, or even wild feature suggestions. Let’s shape the future of the game together!

• 🧼 Cleaning weapons
• 💸 Customers will be able to sell their skinned weapons to us by making an offer
• 🏛️ Weapon museum
• 🎯 New and detailed shooting target system
• 🔫 All weapons are going to be usable for shooting anywhere or anyone :)
• 📈 Investments can be made in Defense Companies — this will have several benefits
• 🧽 Cleaning weapon shells in the range
• 📱 Determining which weapons can be rented in a new app
• 🔜 And much more!

Don't forget to wishlist and follow our full game:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2967850/Shooting_Range_Simulator/ ]Shooting Range Simulator Full Version[/url]

Join our Discord, give any feedback, report bugs or just enjoy the community:
